title: Addon Resource Link Check Product Flow
problem: Nako has a resource_link_check addon contract but no product route that checks a host-owned selected resource link by opaque ids.
gates: cargo check -p nako-addon-protocol -p nako-addon-client -p nako-api -p nako-server --tests
evidence: Added Admin API DTOs and generated TypeScript contract entries for selected resource link checks.
Added server tests proving raw URL/password/context are not accepted from the browser and are not leaked in responses.
Verified targeted nextest, cargo fmt --check, and focused cargo check gates.

continue_policy.notes: Lane closed. Split Admin UI, checker providers, downloader, cloud-drive transfer, and password/code persistence.
